note: Muse Code has no local policy file and no offline decision oracle: permission profiles are select-never-create and approvals route through an LLM reviewer (adapters/muse-code-assessment.md, 2026-10-22). This file records that fact so a check run can name what it examined. Nothing here is a policy and nothing here is measured.
